Character Arc

  • CURIE: gmeow:CharacterArc
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CharacterArc
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/narrative

A first-class interpretive/structural information object describing a character's trajectory through a narrative — a standpoint-scoped analysis, never canonical truth. A gufo:Kind with distinct identity criteria (subject, frame, and type). Cross-continuity variants are linked by counterpartOf, never merged.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:InformationObject

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:CharacterArc as a specialized kind of gmeow:InformationObject. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:InformationObject
